contact.name: Karas Wright
contact.evidence_quote: I'm Karas Wright — Leadership Coach, Systems Business Coach, Strategist, and Trusted Thinking Partner. After 25 years in corporate banking, I led thriving teams and managed complex portfolios. But what stuck with me most wasn't the numbers — it was the people.

contacts.rung: Principal / director (no Erasmus contact found). She founded and owns Wright Step Coaching and is the sole named person running the business, making her the only point of contact.
